payload.title: feat/one-subject-per-run at 0cda2f8: a run subject keeps its patch apart from its inputs (owner reading of R-0HABWN#7)
payload.body: Commit 0cda2f8 on branch feat/one-subject-per-run, from 3ec4979. Applies the owner's return of R-0HABWN#7: an input file is data given to the code, not a patch. A run subject keeps {base, patch, files}; a based Hypothesis subject is held by a run at its base whose patch, if any, is one of its files, so a run at B given inputs covers bare B and a run at B plus a patch never does. Code and tests were written, and go test run, while building, before E's rule; the rule's checks run after it.

why: The candidate that applies the owner's reading of R-0HABWN#7.
0cda2f8 holds 3ec4979 and applies the owner's return of R-0HABWN#7.

payload.title: Removals, vet and test, census on 0cda2f8
payload.body: Supports only if all hold. Rules: R7 a run keeps its patch apart from its inputs (R-0HABWN#7 as returned); R3a-R3d, F1, F3-F6 as E-2XGWNC. (a) Per rule, one removal of its check from 0cda2f8 in a detached worktree fails its tests on their assertion; diff non-empty, output logged. F4 has no own check: its removal compares files as lists. R7 also: 3ec4979's exact-files compare restored fails TestRunWithInputsCoversBareBase. (b) go vet, go test -count=1 pass. (c) status, check same bytes: 0cda2f8 vs installed (10540106) on 4 trees; vs 33896ec (2297b148) on 3; sha256s logged, 0cda2f8's differs.

why: Pre-registers 0cda2f8's rule before its checks run. 4 trees: id-citation, recipe-base, checkpoint-store-design, checkpoint-store; the 3 are the first three.
